name: pi-web-workspace
description: Browser view and control surface over Pi sessions (independent project; Pi executes, pi-web renders and relays)

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:packages && npm run build -w @pi-web/client && node scripts/stage-client-dist.mts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/pi-adapter/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc -p packages/client/tsconfig.json --noEmit
